title: 906. Complete Binary Tree Inserter

examples.explanation: Inserting 3 under parent 1 and 4 under parent 2 keeps the tree complete; getRoot reports 1.
Both insertions attach to the root, whose value stays 1.
Node 7 fills the right child of 3 and node 8 the left child of 4.
